patchwork_fixes.configuration.title: Patchwork
patchwork_fixes.configuration.modules.to: Each module fixes one mod and only runs if that mod is installed at a version it was written for.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.biolith.to: Biolith (bundled in Quark and others): biome lookups during world generation stop creating new objects every call. Same biomes.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.terrablend: TerraBlender: no throwaway function per surface block during world generation. Same terrain.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.terrainsla: Terrain Slabs: scans each column once instead of 3 block reads and 3 new objects per block. Same slabs.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.voicelesss: Voiceless Survival: mob memory leak fix
Voiceless Survival kept every mob that ever spawned in memory for the whole session. This frees them when they leave the world.
Removes Essential's cosmetics from player rendering. Friends, world hosting and messaging keep working.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.eatinganim: Eating and drinking animations without Groovy ModLoader (about 100 MB less memory). Off automatically while the original Eating Animation mod is installed.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.subtleeffe: Subtle Effects re-checks the biome, its config conditions and long block lists for every animated block, every tick. This works each answer out once per tick and reuses it. The effects look exactly the same. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.accelerate: With a shader pack on, Accelerated Rendering's forced translucent batching shows the sky through player and piglin heads. This sends only those translucent models through the normal path while shaders draw the world; everything else stays accelerated. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.watut: What Are They Up To: Live GUI Preview
patchwork_fixes.configuration.watut.tool: Makes the floating preview of another player's open menu update live and look sharper, removes its flicker, and only sends the pixels that changed. Also fixes crashes from bad preview packets and frees memory when players leave. Every player needs Patchwork for the live preview. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.supplement: With Quark installed, using the wrench on a block that has no item (like the side of hanging cave vines) crashed the game. Those blocks are now skipped by the wood check. Everything else rotates as before. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.campfirere: Campfire Resting sent every player's rest data to everyone in the dimension, and clients that did not have that player loaded threw an error each time (tens of thousands per session). Updates now go only to players who can see that player. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.nomadicten: Right-clicking a tent door with a mallet often teleported you inside instead of packing the tent up, because the mod checked the wrong hand. The door now uses the hand you clicked with, and holding a mallet stops the walk-in teleport. Needs a restart.
patchwork.version_changed.title: Patchwork
patchwork.version_changed.body.one: %s updated, so its fix is off for now. The game works normally.
patchwork.version_changed.body.many: %s updated, so their fixes are off for now. The game works normally.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.streamsref: Streams Reflowing: No Stall Dump Files
Streams Reflowing writes a thread dump to disk whenever chunk generation stalls. This turns on the mod's own switch to stop those files. River generation is unchanged. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.midnightli: Mods that use MidnightLib (like Smooth Steps) could crash the game at startup when two of them loaded their settings at the same moment. This makes them take turns. Settings are unchanged. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.iris.toolt: Some shader packs (like Bliss) keep data in images they never clear. Iris created those images with leftover video memory, which showed up as a strong yellow-green glow near you at sunset and night. This starts them empty. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.irisshader: Each time the game starts, Iris rewrites every program of your shader pack before it can show it, which takes a second or more. This keeps the rewritten programs on disk (at most 64 MB) and reuses them only when the pack, its settings, your mods and your graphics driver are exactly the same. Same shaders. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.soundwatch: If Minecraft's sound thread crashes (for example when memory runs out) or stops answering, the game used to freeze the next time a sound played. Now that sound is skipped and the sound thread is restarted. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.irisnameta: With a shader pack, player and mob name tags cast a shadow floating in the air. This leaves name tags out of the shadow, which also makes shadows a little faster. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.signtext.t: Text on signs farther away than the distance below is too small to read, but drawing it still costs a lot with many signs around. Past that distance only the sign is drawn; looking through a spyglass still shows the text. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.signTextDi: How far away (in blocks) sign text is still drawn. Used by the sign text fix above.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.rendertype: With a shader pack, banners ask for the same long name of each pattern layer every frame, and the game rebuilt it every time. Now it is built once. Looks the same, banners draw faster. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.seamlesslo: Seamless Loading Screen: Fix Crash on Leaving

Seamless Loading Screen only learned a world's name when you opened it from the world list. Worlds opened another way (for example by an auto-start mod) crashed the game when you left them. Now every world gets its name, so leaving works and its loading screenshot is saved. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.loadmychun: Load My Chunks: Fix Freeze and Exit Hang

Load My Chunks could get stuck in an endless loop when chunks loaded while it was ticking entities, freezing the world and making the game hang when you quit. This makes it work from a snapshot of the loaded chunks. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.nestedjars: Many mods bundle other jars inside themselves, and the mod loader keeps every one of those whole in memory for the entire session. This saves each one once to cache/patchwork/nested-jars and reads it from there instead, freeing that memory. Same files, nothing else changes. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.villagerap: Villager API: Scan Packs Once Per World

Villager API looked for its villager packs again, across every mod, for each step of starting a world. This keeps the first result until the world closes, so worlds open about a second faster. Packs added while a world is open show up the next time you open it. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.skinlayers: 3D Skin Layers: Skip in Shader Shadows

With a shader pack on, 3D Skin Layers drew every player's 3D outer layer a second time just for the shadow. The shadow now uses the flat outer layer instead, for about 10% more FPS. Players and their shadow outlines look the same. Needs a restart.
